title: MS31001: Photonic Materials And Applications
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Optical and optoelectronic properties of semiconductors, Electronic structure,
refractive index, electro-luminescence, electro-optic effects, and laser
phenomena. Microphotonic materials and structures; photonic band gap
materials. Materials design and processing for lasers, LEDs waveguides,
modulators, switches, displays and optoelectronic integrated circuits.
